title: Existence of the normalized scalar Roos lift
statement: The realization and constant-tower transpose construction produces a scalar-extended strict Roos map with zero shifted coordinate, normalized quotient coordinates, and the displayed factorization through the scalar counit.

proof.text: Choose a simultaneous strict quotient presentation and a K-injective tower resolution; apply the constant-tower/limit adjunction and the normalized Roos bridge.
